description: This file defines the TranslationInterface, an interface for translation services in Drupal, including methods for translating strings, translating TranslatableMarkup objects, and formatting plural strings.

classes.name: TranslationInterface
classes.description: Interface for the translation.manager translation service, providing methods for string translation and pluralization.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a string to the current or specified language, returning a TranslatableMarkup object.

methods.name: translateString
methods.description: Translates a TranslatableMarkup object to a string.

methods.name: formatPlural
methods.description: Formats a string containing a count of items, ensuring correct pluralization.
